scope: Durable local queue and separate Node restart process; no model or remote side effect.

cases.expected: Explicit ensureTask permits empty list/next/stop/resume; reads do not create missing tasks.
The same task/message ID and text produces one queued message.
The same message ID with different text conflicts without rewriting original intent.
Only one instruction may be sending; completion permits the next queued ID.
Enqueueing a follow-up preserves current sending state and does not pause.
Stop preserves active and pending messages; confirmed completion still needs explicit resume.
Uncertain delivery blocks all later dispatch and cannot be bypassed by resume.
Reopening a sending queue persists uncertain status before allowing any dispatch.
A new Node process dispatches only the pending message and preserves both completion records.
Uncertain resolution requires evidence and explicit resume before the next message.
An acknowledgement for another task does not complete the active instruction.
Invalid IDs, empty text and messages over20000 characters are rejected.
Mutating list output cannot change durable text or instruction status.
